audit_title: Patient-Level Cross-Dataset Provenance and Linkage Audit

pairwise_linkages.blocker_description: GCHTID tile filenames (e.g. 'ADI-001.png', 'TUM-124.png') consist of generic 3-letter tissue class prefixes followed by sequential integers. They do not encode patient IDs, hospital admission numbers, or slide accession codes. Conversely, HMU-GC-Clinical contains 300 integer patient identifiers in the 1600000 range. No lookup table or crosswalk file exists in the repository connecting tile sequence numbers to patient IDs.
pairwise_linkages.unblocking_requirements: Requires an institutional crosswalk mapping each GCHTID image tile (or original WSI file) to its corresponding Harbin Medical University patient identifier (`Patient`).

pairwise_linkages.blocker_description: Gastric.xlsx is a computational target prediction table for microRNA hsa-miR-497-5p across human genes (derived from DIANA-microT, miRanda, TargetScan, etc.). It contains zero patient identifiers, clinical specimens, or patient-level molecular expression data. HMU-GC-Clinical contains patient clinical staging but zero miRNA quantification.
pairwise_linkages.unblocking_requirements: Requires patient-matched miRNA expression quantification (e.g., RT-qPCR or miRNA-Seq) measuring hsa-miR-497-5p expression levels in the 300 HMU patients.

pairwise_linkages.blocker_description: No biological or specimen linkage exists connecting isolated H&E histological tiles to predicted molecular interactions of hsa-miR-497-5p.
pairwise_linkages.unblocking_requirements: Requires spatial transcriptomics or matched tissue molecular profiling of histological slides.

scientific_integrity_rules_enforced: Prohibition of heuristic joins by row ordering or sorting
Prohibition of synthetic patient ID generation
Prohibition of transferring patch-level labels into patient-level diagnoses
Prohibition of treating in-silico predicted interactions as patient molecular biomarkers
